name: Statistical Volume Map Overlay
definition: A volume rendering technique that integrates statistical volume maps (VMP) into the ray-casting pipeline to visualize activated brain regions alongside underlying anatomical data, rendering map values both outside and inside the anatomical volume with adjustable blending.
summary: Statistical Volume Map Overlay integrates continuous statistical maps into ray-casting to visualize activated regions alongside anatomy, differing from segmentation overlays by allowing adjustable blending both inside and outside the volume.
